name: Prison Policy Initiative
summary: A US research and advocacy organisation on mass incarceration, based in Northampton, Massachusetts, with about a dozen staff. It publishes the data behind reform campaigns (Mass Incarceration: The Whole Pie, jail and phone-rate studies), led the campaign against prison gerrymandering and has campaigned for two decades against the cost of prison and jail phone calls, and gives technical support to advocates in about 24 states.

spending.source: https://static.prisonpolicy.org/financials/PPI_financials_2025.pdf (audited statements, year ended June 30 2025, p. 6: program services $1,728,751 of total functional expenses $1,911,368)
